key_findings: Ablation of Nav1.8+ nociceptors in HSV-1 infected mice causes larger skin lesions, excess cytokines and persistent neutrophil infiltration without affecting viral clearance.
Nociceptor-deficient mice have impaired DC antigen presentation and reduced CD8 T cell expansion.
